title: SPDB v1.0.0 — Spanish Political Discourse Annotation Resource
description: SPDB is a reproducible annotation resource for pragmatic-function coding in Spanish parliamentary discourse. Version 1.0.0 provides schemas, guidelines, ParlaMint-derived sampling, and a completed two-annotator Wave-1 reliability pilot (N=100; observed agreement 0.350; Cohen kappa ~0.235; Krippendorff alpha ~0.223; Fleiss kappa ~0.219; 65 disagreements). Revised codebook-v1.1.0 remains unvalidated. Not an adjudicated gold benchmark.
